items.vo: Brands pay creators per view — but budgets run out first come, first served, and payouts are a black box.

items.caption: A fixed USDC pool, split fairly by views
items.vo: ClipPool fixes that: a brand locks a fixed USDC pool on Arc, and it's split fairly by views.

items.caption: Pay only for traction — capped per creator
items.vo: Your payout is your share of total views, capped so no single creator takes it all.

items.caption: Built for paying lots of people, fast
items.vo: And because it runs on Arc, paying hundreds of creators is instant and costs fractions of a cent.

items.caption: Launch a campaign
items.vo: A brand opens the campaign builder…

items.caption: Title + rules — the rules hash is stored onchain
items.vo: …writes the brief and the rules — their hash is pinned onchain, so they can't change later…

items.caption: Pool, schedule, per-creator cap, min views
items.vo: …sets the pool, the schedule, a per-creator cap and minimum views.

items.caption: One signature (EIP-2612 permit)…
items.vo: One signature…

items.caption: …one transaction: USDC locked in ClipPool
items.vo: …one transaction, and the USDC is locked in the ClipPool contract.

items.caption: Campaign is live onchain
items.vo: The campaign is live.

items.caption: Post a YouTube Short
items.vo: A creator posts a YouTube Short…

items.caption: Submit — no gas, no signup fee
items.vo: …and submits it. No gas, no signup fee.

items.caption: No wallet? Continue with Google
items.vo: No crypto wallet? Continue with Google…

items.caption: A USDC wallet on Arc, via Circle — no seed phrase
items.vo: …and Circle creates a USDC wallet on Arc — no seed phrase. Connect YouTube proves channel ownership, read-only.

items.caption: Paste the Short — checked against YouTube
items.vo: The Short is checked against YouTube: public, under three minutes, posted in the window…

items.caption: You're in
items.vo: …and you're in.

items.caption: Live leaderboard with estimated payouts
items.vo: Everyone sees the live split.
When the campaign ends, an oracle snapshots views and posts a Merkle root onchain. Anyone can recompute the split — and it matches.

items.caption: One claimMany pays every creator — final in < 1 s
items.vo: After a short review window, one transaction pays every creator in USDC — final in under a second.

items.caption: Creator wallet: +2.00 USDC
items.vo: The creator's wallet shows the payout.
USDC as gas, instant finality, native USDC and EURC, and Circle wallets — that's why this runs on Arc.
ClipPool. Get paid for every view — fairly.
